result:
All 9 tests passed (`bash tests/run_tests.sh` from the repo root), and only the intended files were modified — `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, and `report.sh` are untouched.

Summary of what was done:

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed the rotation logic: the guard is now `total -le keep` (nothing to delete when exactly N exist), and surplus is `head -n "$((total - keep))"` (the *oldest* entries) instead of `tail -n +"$keep"` (which selected the newest). Replaced the inline option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` with a source of `lib/common.sh`; same flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-q/--quiet`, `-h/--help`) and exit codes verified by smoke test.
- **`verify.sh`** — fixed sidecar parsing: the archive name is now everything after the digest and trailing whitespace (so names with spaces survive) instead of awk field `$2`, and the digest comparison is quoted. Same refactor to source `lib/common.sh`.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option-parsing loop, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`; sources `lib/log.sh` (with double-source guards, bash 3.2-compatible, log prefixes unchanged).
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a rotate group (keeps all N with exactly N, including the newest; deletes the oldest when over N) and a verify group for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` reporting `ok` with rc=0.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh`.
